Cancer surveillance and other recommende.Test type: Detailed cancer-related history and physical examination
Cancer surveillance and other recommende.When / how often: Every 3 to 6 months for the first 3 years after primary therapy, every 6 to 12 months for the next 2 years, and annually thereafter
Cancer surveillance and other recommende.Explanation: Regular detailed cancer-related history and physical examination are essential for monitoring recurrence and managing any arising complications.
Colonoscopy is recommended for general cancer screening and is particularly important for patients with a history of cancer.
CT colonography is recommended for general cancer screening and is particularly important for patients with a history of cancer.

Cancer surveillance and other recommende.Test type: Low-dose CT (LDCT) for lung cancer screening
Cancer surveillance and other recommende.When / how often: Annually for current or former smokers aged 55-74 with at least a 30 pack-year smoking history
Cancer surveillance and other recommende.Explanation: LDCT screening is recommended for lung cancer surveillance in high-risk individuals, including those with a significant smoking history.

Cancer surveillance and other recommende.When / how often: Annually for postmenopausal women on selective estrogen receptor modulator therapies (SERMs)
Cancer surveillance and other recommende.Explanation: Annual gynecologic assessments are recommended for postmenopausal women on SERMs due to the increased risk of endometrial cancer.
